MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Echo Show felt useful because its screen would give me a new bedside role alongside my Fire TV devices, rather than repeat something I already have.",
    "The HDMI cable fits my TV and monitor setup, and the smart plug could add useful Alexa control, although I would wait for a concrete need before buying either."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The older and HD Fire TV sticks repeat streaming functions already covered by my 4K stick and Fire TV television without offering a clear improvement.",
    "The tablet, memory card, and Wi-Fi extender address needs I have not expressed: another portable screen, a particular storage format, or a coverage problem.",
    "A separate Echo speaker is less compelling when I would prefer the Echo Show's screen; I do not need both just because they work with Alexa."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My Fire TV purchases seem to have been taken as a reason to recommend more Amazon and Alexa devices, even when their purpose does not fit what I need now.",
    "Owning cameras and screens seems to have been treated as enough reason to suggest storage and networking accessories without a confirmed compatibility or setup need."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My existing equipment matters: another streaming device needs to add a useful capability beyond my current 4K setup.",
    "I distinguish something that could fit my setup from something I would buy now; cables and automation accessories need a specific use.",
    "My recent camera and television purchases make practical additions to that setup more relevant than an older tablet or a speaker with no distinct role."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "You recognized my interest in connected video equipment, but leaned too heavily on related devices without considering what I already own or need next."
}
